original_test_intent: Validate the M-suffixed GB GPU power sensor family across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence against an approved, suffix-specific power specification.
original_method: The owner resolves whether the family ends at a fixed GPU8 or a platform-dependent X, defines M and its relation to unsuffixed power, maps every resulting sensor to stable GPU identity and electrical boundary, and permits passive collection only.
manual_activity: The platform/power owner dispositions the X-versus-8 conflict, defines M and its boundary, approves exact population and stable GPU mapping, then reviews the suffix-specific evidence.
required_inputs: Approved disposition of Procedure PWR_GB_GPU1~X_M versus Items PWR_GB_GPU1~8_M
Exact fitted member list and whether X is fixed at eight or derived from configuration
Authoritative meaning of M and distinction from unsuffixed PWR_GB_GPU1 through GPU8
Per-member board/slot/module, serial, UUID and PCI BDF mapping
Sensor producer and electrical boundary for M channels
Units, scale, polarity, averaging/integration window, refresh, stale and not-present semantics
M-specific expected ranges by GPU power state, workload state, cooling/ambient and platform policy
Approved relationship or expected delta between M and unsuffixed channels, if any
Complete SDR/Sensor List/Web identity mapping, secret-safe collectors and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Do not choose X=8 merely because Items and DeepSeek say eight; obtain an approved source-conflict disposition
Do not infer M or substitute unsuffixed readings for M-suffix coverage
Resolve exact names individually instead of executing either tilde range
Bind one-based labels to stable physical identities and a defined electrical boundary
Do not induce workload, reload drivers, reset GPUs, command power, alter thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on unresolved selector, missing/stale/implausible readings, identity drift, GPU/power/thermal fault or incomplete views
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row, unique code, selector conflict and owner disposition
Verify exact M-family population, suffix semantics, stable GPU map and unsuffixed relationship
Collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List, every approved exact M sensor and BMC Web
Compare boundary-specific readings under passive state with unsuffixed context only if owner-authorized
Perform no invented endpoint, suffix inference, workload, GPU/driver/power/BMC/log mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve fixed GPU8 versus configuration-dependent X and publish exact names
Define M, its telemetry producer/boundary and relation to unsuffixed channels
Approve stable GPU identities, timing semantics and state-qualified M limits
Review all approved members and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not acceptance-ready: it silently selects the GPU8 interpretation, queries a literal range, truncates SDR, exposes credentials and lacks complete required views.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner disposition, enumerate each exact M sensor and collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List and Web evidence with stable GPU and boundary context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Items GPU1-GPU8_M scope and 3/3-minute estimates are preserved as one conflicting source claim; Procedure X_M remains preserved and unresolved.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES SELECTOR CONFLICT DISPOSITION, M-SEMANTIC CONTRACT AND EXACT MEMBER MAP
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Publish a configuration-specific member manifest first, then map exact M channels to GPU identities, producer/boundary and suffix-specific acceptance envelopes before collection.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents the collection tool from silently resolving an authored endpoint conflict and treating an unexplained suffix as a cosmetic label.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The unsuffixed GB family may provide correlation but gives no M-channel coverage until the owner defines their relationship.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If X is population-dependent, hard-coding eight can fabricate failures for absent devices or omit configured devices beyond the assumed endpoint; if M is a distinct rail or statistic, applying unsuffixed limits is equally invalid.

project_override_considerations: A project-approved selector correction must be recorded in the Review layer without rewriting Master. Configuration-dependent populations require explicit expected-absence records.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, unique-code search and preserved X-versus-8 source conflict
Owner-approved selector disposition, exact member manifest and M definition
M producer/boundary, units, timing, state-qualified limits and any approved unsuffixed relationship
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus every exact M result
BMC Web, same-target proof and passive GPU/power/thermal context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and DeepSeek name a GPU1-GPU8_M family, while both IB and OOB Procedure filters name GPU1-X_M. The authoritative endpoint and exact population cannot be selected without an owner-approved disposition.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The M-family power intent is identifiable, and the selector conflict, suffix semantics and criteria can be supplied as project inputs without altering Master.

review_improvement: Preserves the endpoint conflict, prevents an implicit X=8 assumption, and requires M-specific electrical semantics instead of copying the unsuffixed family contract.
independent_technical_reasoning: The letter X can denote a variable population, not simply a typo for 8. Resolving it inside a command would change coverage silently; moreover, an M suffix may identify a different rail, measurement point or statistic, so even matching numeric readings cannot establish equivalence without an engineering definition.
